content.title: Listen and share recordings
content.summary: Collect up to two audio recordings per person and share each acknowledged recording with its original author.
content.setup: The host supplies eligible actors and a contribution window. Filling the contribution limit does not close it early. Each reader claim and acknowledgment has a 30-second timeout.
content.participant: Submit up to two ready audio recordings. Claim another person’s recording, listen/play it, then acknowledge if it should be shared with attribution.
content.completion: Iterate finally eligible accepted items in acceptance order. Claim or acknowledgment timeout skips publication; without a possible non-author reader, the item skips immediately. An empty pool creates no sharing rounds.
content.access: Private contributions stay with their author. The non-author who claims an item receives its material and attribution. Successful acknowledgment shares that actual contribution with all bound viewers; timeout preserves privacy, while an assigned reader keeps access.

provenance.rights: Authors retain rights to their contributions; this definition grants no media rights.

steps.prompt: Offer up to two ready audio recordings.
Claim this contribution if it is not your own.
Read or play your assigned contribution, then acknowledge to share it with attribution.
